{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nightfighters''' were a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of eight [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. One pilot was a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]]. The squadron was considered less well-known than [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. The Nightfighters' base was located in a small, spaceborne facility concealed inside of a [[Comet/Legends|cometary]] ice mass with a long solar orbit. The facility was staffed with talented [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]], and outfitted with the best equipment.<ref name="Gamer 9">{{GamerCite|9|On Wings of Rogues}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightfighters is used as an example of how to create a squadron in ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[2002]] article ''[[On Wings of Rogues]]'' in [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]].<ref name="Gamer 9" />
